interest: This file provides a concise record of inter-Asian sports diplomacy and cultural exchange in the mid-1930s, documenting athletic ties between the Philippines and Japan prior to World War II. It illustrates how the State Department monitored amateur athletic competitions, such as track and field meets organized by the Japan Amateur Athletic Federation, during a period of evolving U.S.-Philippine-Japanese relations following the establishment of the Commonwealth of the Philippines. Additionally, it highlights State Department archival practices, demonstrating how regional sporting events were cross-referenced between country-specific subject files and general recreation classifications.
overview: This file consists of a single U.S. State Department document file note (cross-reference sheet) classified under decimal file 894.40632, relating to outdoor sports, amusements, and athletic contests in Japan. The sheet indexes Despatch No. 1363, dated June 24, 1935, from the American Embassy in Japan (headed by Ambassador Joseph C. Grew) to the Department of State, which was filed under decimal file 032 Philippine Athletic Teams/1. It notes the visit of Philippine athletic teams to Japan and the opening of a track and field meet in Tokyo on Saturday, June 15, 1935, organized pursuant to an invitation extended by the Japan Amateur Athletic Federation.

subfiles.about: A Department of State cross-reference sheet indexing Despatch No. 1363 regarding the visit and track and field competitions of the Philippine athletic team in Tokyo.
subfiles.from: Joseph C. Grew (U.S. Embassy, Tokyo, Japan)
subfiles.summary: This cross-reference sheet directs researchers to decimal file 032 Philippine Athletic Teams/1 for Despatch No. 1363, dated June 24, 1935, from the U.S. Embassy in Tokyo. It reports on the visit of Philippine athletic teams to Japan and the commencement of a track and field competition held in Tokyo on Saturday, June 15, 1935. The event was staged following an official invitation extended to the Philippine team by the Japan Amateur Athletic Federation.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Despatch No. 1363 on Visit of Philippine Athletic Teams to Japan
